pages.text: Choose carefully — your race is picked once at character creation and $(bold)cannot be changed.$()$(br2)Races modify secondary stats only; HP% and damage% belong to classes. The interaction between race and class is where build identity comes from — the same class played by two different races feels meaningfully different.

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Human$() — Versatile. Efficient. Small hitbox.$(li)$(bold)Faefolk$() — Nature-attuned. Iron weakness. Slow fall.
